answer: Price each identity to a scarce hardware anchor it must forge a signed liveness proof from every epoch; standing accrues only as a non-transferable relic earned by a long unbroken thread of peer-audited work co-signed by already-established peers from separate funding clusters. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet forges one thread, so every relic traces back to that single root and never multiplies across distinct clusters, so the farm pays to forge and age a distinct anchor per head while an honest agent pays once.
